Subject: Week 18: Forecast Sprint — Submit, Stabilize, and Evidence Pass

Team / Anna —

Quick week-18 kickoff for the forecast sprint. Two asks before the 3pm PT submission slot: update CRM stages and assemble evidence packets. Please read the short agenda and confirm owners by EOD: 

Agendas / asks (short):
- CRM hygiene: set stage to "Commit" or "At-Risk" with notes (update close date + probability). Target: noon PT.
- Evidence pass: attach the minimal evidence artifact in the shared drive under /Q2/Evidence (see link). Marissa: can you own Acme's evidence packet?
- Large deals (> $100k ARR): flag with tag "escalate-finance" and ping me directly.
- Precall: 15min standing at 2:45pm PT to finalize numbers; Meet link below.

Attachments: Q2_evidence_roster.xlsx, 15min_precall_agenda.pdf (stubs attached)
Links: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/8891, https://meet.google.com/rdw-forecast-15m

Why this matters: finance needs the committed line to be reconciled against procurement and legal holds before close-of-day submission. If Acme needs a PO confirmation or procurement signoff beyond today, flag it so we can count as "pending-procurement" rather than hard commit.

Next steps (for recipients):
- Marissa: own evidence upload for Acme + quick checklist in the drive.
- Priyom: run a quick streak of late-stage deals and flag any that moved > one stage since last week.
- Grace: pull the ledger-aligned committed amounts for the submission + reconcile with my list.
- Anna / Acme: confirm if procurement can send PO by EOD or if you need an alternate capture method.

Thanks — I want a clean submission at 3:00pm PT. Ping with any blockers.

Jonas
Jonas Weber | VP Revenue Operations

2) Evidence: upload minimal proof and add the checklist stanza.
